shuka_unique_rows.source_title: 国際日本文化研究センター 和歌データベース 新古今集
shuka_unique_rows.match_note: Corresponding poem by 長方 has textual variants: database 紀の国や / 由良のみなと; project Shuka transcription 紀の国の / 由良のみさき. Refer to 出典歌の部立（異同あり）, not exact-transcription proof.

notes: The 33 season annotations, including H026 雑（秋）, agree with all 33 existing CSV season labels. This independently verifies the categories against a public museum reference, not against all scholarly editions.
The museum lists two books as references but the books themselves were not directly inspected.
For the 97 common Shuka songs the Ogura reference can be linked as a same-poem reference, explicitly labelled 小倉の対応歌の部立; do not claim the museum independently classified the Shuka transcription.

H064 source_number differs: existing CSV 千載集 冬419 vs All Japan Karuta Association 冬420. H067 CSV 雑上961 vs association964. H078 CSV 金葉集冬288 vs association270. Do not silently repair the base dataset; seasonal divisions agree, poem-number edition differences need separate collation.
Nichibun additionally confirms H078 as the main entry 00270 with 異同資料句番号 00288, so the existing 288 vs 270 difference may be a numbering-system difference, not an error.
retrieval_method: 100 museum URLs were fetched read-only through HTTPS on 2026-09-20; each page 歌番号 was checked against the requested 1..100 and only 部立/出典 factual metadata were extracted. Selected poems were also read through web browse. Four Shuka-only source poems were checked through the web tool against Nichibun anthology heading and corresponding poem number. No raw HTML, poems, translations, or commentary retained in this note.
